episodes.title: Part 1: The Key and the Clock
episodes.summary: Detective Joe Miller is on the case after two men are found burned to death in a pawn shop following a deal gone bad involving a mysterious key.

episodes.title: Part 2: The Comb and the Box
episodes.summary: Anna contacts her father; Joe meets up with Jennifer and receives help from the Legion; Dr. Ruber's story is questioned; Kreutzfeld gives Joe a history lesson on the objects.

episodes.title: Part 3: The Eye and the Prime Object
episodes.summary: Joe tries to save his daughter by using his resources and alliances, but one of his allies has a separate agenda, one that imperils the world.
